description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class for the CountryService within the OrangeHRM Admin module. It includes test methods for verifying DAO interactions, retrieving country and province data, and normalizing country data into an array format.

classes.name: CountryServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CountryService class functionalities within the OrangeHRM HRM system's Admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a new instance of CountryService before each test.

methods.name: testGetCountryDao
methods.description: Tests that getCountryDao returns a CountryDao instance and that the setter properly sets the DAO.

methods.name: testSetCountryDao
methods.description: Verifies setting and retrieving the CountryDao within the service.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of Country objects from the service.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of Province objects from the service.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Tests fetching a Country object by its name, including handling of non-existent entries.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Tests fetching a Country object by its code, including handling of non-existent entries.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests fetching a Province object by its code, including handling of non-existent entries.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Tests transforming a list of Country objects into an array with normalized id and label, utilizing NormalizerService.
